json_patch.value: Fix: fix: emit LLMGuardrailCompletedEvent when a guardrail raises. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/utilities/guardrail.py, lib/crewai/tests/test_guardrail_events_on_exception.py. `process_guardrail` now emits `LLMGuardrailCompletedEvent(success=False, error="<Type>: <msg>")` and re-raises when the guardrail callable raises a non-`HookAborted` exception, mirroring the existing `HookAborted` branch (which keeps its exact legacy error string). (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/8403)
